bullets.text: Securing AI Supply Chains - **Microsoft** emphasizes the need for robust security in AI application supply chains to mitigate risks.
AI-Driven Threat Detection - **Microsoft** introduces an AI-assisted workflow to streamline threat report analysis and enhance security.
Data Security Index Insights - **Microsoft's** report reveals critical priorities for secure AI adoption and data protection.
Windows 11 Insider Updates - New builds released for **Windows 11** Insiders, enhancing user experience and fixing bugs.
Celebrating Security Excellence - **Microsoft** honors innovators in cybersecurity at the 2026 Security Excellence Awards.
Introducing Maia 200 - **Microsoft** unveils Maia 200, a powerful AI inference accelerator designed for efficiency.
Government Data Security Strategies - **Microsoft** outlines proactive measures for safeguarding governmental data against cyber threats.
